cards.name: Naomi
cards.note: A baker with flour on her sleeves and a dry answer for everything.

cards.name: Grandma Esther
cards.note: Joppa's baker for fifty years, still guiding her girl one letter at a time.

cards.name: Caleb
cards.note: A boat builder of few words who answers most questions with work.

cards.name: Joy
cards.note: Eight years old, barefoot, and always one honey cake short of content.

cards.name: Silas
cards.note: An old fisherman whose stories take the long way round to the point.

cards.name: Zilpah
cards.note: Queen of the well, with a fine embroidered shawl and very sharp eyes.

cards.name: Marcus
cards.note: A young official who hides a sore heart behind a quick tongue.

cards.name: Tabitha
cards.note: A disciple full of good works, who made coats and garments for the widows.

cards.name: Esther's Bakehouse
cards.note: Fifty years of early mornings live in this oven's warm stones.

cards.name: The Town Well
cards.note: Water is drawn here every morning, and so is all the news in Joppa.

cards.name: The Fishing Docks
cards.note: Salt, tar and gull cries, where the boats come home at first light.

cards.name: The Tanner's House
cards.note: Simon the tanner's house by the sea side, where Peter lodged many days.

cards.name: The House Church
cards.note: A small room with borrowed benches and lamps, and space for one more.

cards.name: The Harbor Watchtower
cards.note: It stands over the rocky harbor, waiting for its beacon to burn again.

cards.name: The Marketplace
cards.note: Figs, fish and tall tales, all sold at the top of someone's voice.

cards.name: Caleb's Boatyard
cards.note: Cedar shavings underfoot and a hull taking shape, one plank at a time.

cards.name: Clay Oil Lamp
cards.note: A thumb of flame in a palm of clay, enough to light a whole supper.

cards.name: Fishing Net
cards.note: Mended every evening, knot by knot, ready for the morning's cast.

cards.name: Weaver's Loom
cards.note: Warp and weft and patient hands turn plain thread into a warm tunic.

cards.name: Hand Mill
cards.note: Two stones and a strong arm turn a measure of barley into tomorrow's bread.

cards.name: Water Jar
cards.note: Carried home from the well each dawn, cool and heavy on the shoulder.

cards.name: Bread Basket
cards.note: Woven from palm leaf, and happiest when it goes home empty.

cards.name: Writing Shard
cards.note: A broken bit of pot makes a fine page for a few words worth keeping.

cards.name: Stone Anchor
cards.note: A pierced stone on a rope, holding a small boat steady in a rough harbor.
